WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM `order` o
  INNER JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
average AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_count) as avg_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.account_id,
  g.region,
  g.group_count,
  g.group_count - avg.avg_count as difference
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN average avg
WHERE avg.avg_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
